notes: The two coordinated objects differ only in the ASV's determiner: ten agapen is thy love with no the, so the article is emptied by sou and the case of rides with the noun under rule 21's determinerless clause, while ten pistin is of the faith and rule 21 gives of the to the article headed on the.
Giving the first of to akouon as a phrasal hear of was considered and refused: rule 36 speaks of an expressed Greek preposition and none stands here, so the of is the genitive-object case marker.
